d:
It is not unusual for new Apple products to have flaws. While Apple rarely acknowledges these issues, it typically fixes them quietly. However, in the case of its foldable iPhone—which ranges in price from 3 lakh to 4 lakh rupees—the tech giant has taken a different approach. The company has admitted that its first foldable phone is developing cracks. Media outlets, including Bloomberg and NBC, have reported complaints from several users.
